name: 网格管线 · 方球柱锥与一棵树

brief_zh.subject: 一片平地上摆着方块、球、圆柱、圆锥和一棵用柱加球拼成的树，从近到远排列
brief_zh.style: 结构素描的平涂版本，只用色面分面，不作写实光影
brief_zh.light: 左上方柔和光，暗面统一压一档
brief_zh.camera: 平视，视平线在画高 0.55 处，相机高 1.6 米
brief_zh.palette: 天空 #F4EBDF、地面 #E8DDC4、金 #C9A227、玫红 #C8455F、绿 #7A9A5B、深红 #B3324C

brief_en.subject: a flat ground with a cube, a sphere, a cylinder, a cone and a tree built from a cylinder and a sphere, arranged from near to far
brief_en.style: structural drawing rendered as flat colour planes
brief_en.light: soft light from upper left, shadow sides one step darker
brief_en.camera: eye level, horizon at 0.55 of frame height, camera height 1.6 m
brief_en.palette: sky #F4EBDF, ground #E8DDC4, gold #C9A227, rose #C8455F, green #7A9A5B, deep red #B3324C

layers.name: 网格场景
layers.describe_zh: 同一组几何体，用网格管线重画：顶点、变换、透视投影、面排序、背面剔除
layers.describe_en: the same solids rebuilt through the mesh pipeline: vertices, transforms, perspective projection, face sorting, back-face culling
